sourceTask.excerpt:
# PLATFORM-006 — usable grounded Knowledge answers

READY after accepted local recovery delivery. This bounded contract adopts the Sol/high
core proposal in `.brain/evidence/platform-006-core-proposal-02.md` under the user's
existing full local build authorization and core-delivery priority. It is the current mapped task. Proposed files under `.local/platform-006-prepared`
remain unexecuted until applied; no CP6 test result is claimed.

Concrete source seams are in `.brain/evidence/platform-006-implementation-map-03.md`;
the original-auth callback can flow through existing ctx.assertAllowed without a
new required RequestContext ABI member.

Deliver a question → authorized indexed excerpts → exact cited extractive answer
journey in the Knowledge application workspace. Label the result **Local extractive
answer**. Model inference remains unattached. Knowledge owns its documents,
retrieval, citation meaning and validation. Neutral ai-core owns generic chunk/selection/provider interfaces and a fixed bounded executor; no arbitrary graph/tool execution,
executable URLs or provider credentials.

Add `knowledge.document.retrieve.v1` and `POST /api/documents/answer`, preserving
read.v1 and using knowledge.read/read-kind. Retrieve only the current tenant's
indexed READY records. Citations bind product, instance, tenant, document, version,
body digest and exact excerpt ranges. Construct the local output from validated
source excerpts. Show indexed-only coverage and honest no-evidence results. No
answer database, durable answer job or inferred spend. Add question/cancel/answer/
source title/version/excerpt controls with stale-request fences.

Add backward-compatible captured original request-auth callback support to
backend-host execution/context. Revalidate the same original business session and
actor before consequential reads/provider dispatch and after awaits before
delivery. Existing permission/module-mode checks remain in assertAllowed. Operator
pairing does not grant business access; no global actor registry is introduced.

Update the single-version source coherently: Knowledge/Handoff manifests and
packages 0.2.1; Handoff's exact Knowledge dependency 0.2.1; Knowledge/Combined source
products 0.2.1 selecting those module versions. Knowledge schema stays 1, Handoff
domain/protocol behavior and read.v1 stay unchanged, Desk/Neutral stay unchanged.
Update affected fixtures/lockfile. Preserve old immutable snapshots/releases; no
automatic old-data adoption or general multi-version catalogue.

Repair the necessary export seam: shared pure reviewed workspace dependency closure
starts from fixed host packages and selected module manifests, emits actual package
versions (including ai-core 0.3.0), and verifies captured snapshot bytes. Old
inventories retain their captured old closure. No package download, product-name
branching or edits to exported copies as authority. Expose a distinct lexical/
extractive recipe in source and Studio; legacy embedding/model declarations remain
separate planning surfaces.

Bounds: question 1000 characters, five evidence records, 16 KiB excerpts, 8 KiB
output, five-second deadline and four actual in-flight provider calls. Cancellation
or deadline suppresses late output and retains in-flight reservation until the
actual provider settles. Do not expand into a fault/stress campaign.

Minimum qualification: actual indexed document → answer with exact citations and
no-evidence case; tenant/grant/module denial prevents disclosure/provider input;
logout/cancellation during awaited provider suppresses output; existing Handoff
consumer and new-version export remain coherent. Fresh build, required npm test,
exact independent Sol review and actual application UI qualification are separate
gates. Blocked browser/provider/production gates never become passes.

Root owns Brain; one Luna/xhigh implementation writer; Sol/high planning and
independent read-only review. External repositories, deployments, credentials,
spending and global configuration remain outside scope. Coordinator records actual
